card.name: Word just before a clause or modifier continues
card.fires_on: A noun or verb that ends a short phrase and is about to be followed by a modifier, such as 'therapy', 'infection', 'administration', 'plant' or 'made'. It fires in both drug-label and general web text.

modes.description: A verb or noun ending a relative clause or noun phrase in non-medical prose.
